description: Diagnostic legacy forward brush sweep: fixed grasp-ready brush pose, randomized lightweight block, generic VLM scene-ref grounding from natural task language and public top-down RGB-D evidence, and rollout tracking diagnostics.

scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the red_brush mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance; xy and yaw policy remain fixed unless start_orientation_mode changes.
scene_initialization.block_position_policy: seed 0 uses base_block_xy; later seeds randomize block x by [-0.045, 0.035] and y by [-0.035, 0.045].
scene_initialization.end_point_policy: The contract requires an executable end_point for this tool-contact path; the prompt remains generic and the runner treats a missing end_point as invalid for this benchmark.

mainline_params.table_clearance_rule: all tool-part OBB corners must stay above the table plane

acceptance.success_policy: brush_sweep_directional_displacement: a brush sweep is successful when the target block moves far enough in the intended direction. Strict rollout tracking is diagnostic only.

tool_grounding_contract.notes: Evaluator-side audit labels only; not used for method selection, compiler constraints, or task success. Directional block displacement is the required success metric.

contract_status.notes: Directional target displacement is retained for regression and attribution; red_zone is the headline brush-sweep predicate.
